testHarnessCorrections: Playwright text matching skips NOSCRIPT. The no-JavaScript notice is checked with an explicit CSS locator for visible notice text and contact links.

The tested Firefox engine does not expose the playsInline JavaScript property. The test checks the required playsinline HTML attribute while retaining native playback, pause, timing, theme and fallback checks.

Reading fieldset.disabled with toHaveJSProperty in this Firefox no-JavaScript context repeatedly failed in browser/Juggler code. The test checks the native disabled HTML attribute and retains disabled behavior assertions on every input and button.

Windows WebKit Media Foundation reports a cached display surface as naturalSize and loads media outside Playwright route interception. Manifest declares 768x768; Chromium/Firefox decode checks verify encoded dimensions. The error fixture now uses genuine missing local URLs and DOM source-state assertions. Successful native looping is explicitly skipped on Windows WebKit after the real engine stop was reproduced; a separate actual-media test verifies its graceful fallback.

A follow-up assertion incorrectly required a square video DOM box. The design fills a rectangular stage using object-fit: contain; the corrected test checks matching stage bounds and contain behavior without changing application code.
